description: Cross-domain task-intent triggers. A vague optimization request is authorization to diagnose and fix evidenced UI issues, not to invent defects or override brand decisions.

cases.prompt: 把当前页面整体优化一下，体验更精致
cases.reason: No named defect, so agent must inspect the running page for existing issues before changing CSS

cases.prompt: 这个产品页面可以更好看吗，直接帮我优化
cases.reason: Inspect CTA emphasis, content hierarchy, whitespace and usability rather than only reskinning buttons

cases.prompt: 把这个文档站打磨得舒服一些
cases.reason: Examine readable line length, section rhythm and navigation without forcing a management dashboard

cases.prompt: 改善这个作品展示页的视觉体验
cases.reason: Preserve art direction and evaluate spatial continuity, visual focus and interactive affordances

cases.prompt: 把下面两张独立卡片贴合的问题修复
cases.reason: Target the reported spacing defect and adjacent responsive context, do not force full unrelated redesign

cases.prompt: 修复登录表单提交时的接口报错
cases.reason: An unrelated runtime bug does not require a broad aesthetic redesign

cases.prompt: 请只评估页面设计问题，暂时不要改代码
cases.reason: Respect explicit analysis-only boundary; still inspect for existing defects
